text: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，有序推进接续产能建设，持续推进煤炭资源勘查，强化资源综合评价，提升资源储量规模，保障煤炭接续开发。加强产能总量调控，统筹资源开发潜力、区域供需平衡等因素，合理安排接续产能规模，重点布局在五大供应保障基地内，优先支持上下游一体化产业发展和跨区域煤炭供应保障项目。“十五五”期间，新增产能必须纳入产能“一本账”后组织实施。各类型煤矿新增产能要严格执行产能置换政策
text_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which states that succession capacity construction will be orderly advanced, with continued coal resource exploration, strengthened comprehensive resource evaluation, and enhanced resource reserve scale to ensure continued coal development. Total capacity will be controlled, with succession capacity scale reasonably arranged considering factors like resource development potential and regional supply-demand balance, mainly deployed within five major supply guarantee bases, prioritizing support for upstream-downstream integrated industrial development and cross-regional coal supply assurance projects. During the '15th Five-Year Plan' period, new capacity must be included in the 'one ledger' before implementation. All types of coal mines must strictly implement capacity replacement policies for new capacity.
